senses.gloss:
दभ् दभ्, and दम्भ् दम्भ्, i. 1, दभ, ii. 5, दभ्नु, Par.
 1. To hurt (ved.).
 2. To deceive.
 --Comp. [] ptcple. of the fut. pass. अ-दाभ्य, Not to be checked, Bhāg. P. 4, 23, 4.
 --† i. 10, दाभय, and दम्भय, Par. To send, to impel.
 --† दम्भय, Ātm. To gather.
 --Cf. probably θάμβος, ἔταϕον, τέθηπα; O.H.G. tepjan or depjan.
दभीति दभीति, m. A proper name, Chr. 298, 23 = Rigv. i. 112, 23.

दभ्र दभ् + र, adj. Little, insignificant, Bhāg. P. 6, 7, 11.
 --Comp.
